pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.1.12: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi: “kiṃ nu kho so, ānanda, udukkhalasaddo”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.1.13: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.1.15: tumhehi ānanda, sappurisehi vijitaṃ. pacchimā janatā sālimaṃsodanaṃ atimaññissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: –
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.2: “etarahi bhante, verañjā dubbhikkhā dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.4: imissā bhante mahāpaṭhaviyā heṭṭhimaṃ talaṃ sampannaṃ. seyyathāpi khuddamadhuṃ anīlakaṃ evamassādaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.5: sādhāhaṃ bhante paṭhaviṃ parivatteyyaṃ. bhikkhū pappaṭakojaṃ paribhuñjissantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.6: “ye pana te, moggallāna, paṭhavinissitā pāṇā te kathaṃ karissasī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.7: “ekāhaṃ bhante, pāṇiṃ abhinimminissāmi – seyyathāpi mahāpaṭhavī. ye paṭhavinissitā pāṇā te tattha saṅkāmessāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.9: “alaṃ, moggallāna, mā te rucci paṭhaviṃ parivattetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.11: “sādhu bhante, sabbo bhikkhusaṅgho uttarakuruṃ piṇḍāya gaccheyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:2.2.12: “alaṃ moggallāna, mā te rucci sabbassa bhikkhusaṅghassa uttarakuruṃ piṇḍāya gamana”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.1: atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:–
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.2: “katamesānaṃ kho buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi?
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.3: katamesānaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī?”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.5: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.6: “katamesānaṃ kho buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi? katamesānaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī?”ti. “katamesānaṃ nu kho, bhante, buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi? katamesānaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī?”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.7: “bhagavato ca, sāriputta, vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.1.8: bhagavato ca sāriputta, kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosi”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.1: “ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena bhagavato ca vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī?”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.2: “bhagavā ca, sāriputta, vipassī bhagavā ca sikhī bhagavā ca vessabhū kilāsuno ahesuṃ sāvakānaṃ vitthārena dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.3: appakaṃ ca tesaṃ ahosi suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.5: tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippaññeva antaradhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.6: seyyathāpi sāriputta, nānāpupphāni phalake nikkhittāni suttena asaṅgahitāni, tāni vāto vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.9: evameva kho sāriputta tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippaññeva antaradhāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.10: akilāsuno ca te bhagavanto ahesuṃ sāvake cetasā ceto paricca ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.11: bhūtapubbaṃ sāriputta vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho aññatarasmiṃ bhiṃsanake vanasaṇḍe sahassaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca ovadati anusāsati: –
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.13: evaṃ manasi karotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.15: atha kho sāriputta tassa bhikkhusahassassa vessabhunā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānānaṃ evaṃ anusāsiyamānānaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.16: tatra sudaṃ sāriputta, bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti:– yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati, yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti. –
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.2.17: ayaṃ kho sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena bhagavato ca vipassissa bhagavato ca sikhissa bhagavato ca vessabhussa brahmacariyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.1: “ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena bhagavato ca kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī?”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.2: “bhagavā ca sāriputta kakusandho bhagavā ca koṇāgamano bhagavā ca kassapo akilāsuno ahesuṃ sāvakānaṃ vitthārena dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.3: bahuṃ ca nesaṃ ahosi suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.5: tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena, buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena, ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ ṭhapesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.6: seyyathāpi sāriputta, nānāpupphāni phalake nikkhittāni suttena susaṃgahitāni, tāni vāto na vikirati na vidhamati na viddhaṃseti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.9: evameva kho sāriputta, tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddhānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā, te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ ṭhapesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.3.10: ayaṃ kho, sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena bhagavato ca kakusandhassa bhagavato ca koṇāgamanassa bhagavato ca kassapassa brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ahosī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.3: yaṃ bhagavā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeyya, uddiseyya pātimokkhaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitika”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.6: na tāva sāriputta satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, na uddisati pātimokkhaṃ, yāva na idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti. yato ca kho, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesaññeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.7: na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho rattaññumahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.8: yato ca kho sāriputta, saṅgho rattaññumahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti. atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesaññeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.9: na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho vepullamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.10: yato ca kho sāriputta saṅgho vepullamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesaññeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.11: na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho lābhaggamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.12: yato ca kho sāriputta saṅgho lābhaggamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesaññeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.13: na tāva, sāriputta, idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, yāva na saṅgho bāhusaccamahattaṃ patto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.14: yato ca kho sāriputta, saṅgho bāhusaccamahattaṃ patto hoti, atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti, uddisati pātimokkhaṃ tesaññeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.15: nirabbudo hi sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho nirādīnavo apagatakāḷako suddho sāre patiṭṭhito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.16: imesaṃ hi sāriputta pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu, so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi: –“āciṇṇaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda tathāgatānaṃ yehi nimantitā vassaṃ vasanti, na te anapaloketvā janapadacārikaṃ pakkamanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.3: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.4: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.5: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca: “nimantitamha tayā brāhmaṇa vassaṃ vutthā. apalokema taṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.8: “saccaṃ bho gotama, nimantitattha mayā vassaṃ vutthā. api ca yo deyyadhammo so na dinno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.10: no’pi adātukamyatā. taṃ kutettha labbhā? bahukiccā gharāvāsā bahukaraṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.11: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.13: atha kho bhagavā verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.14: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: “kālo bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.15: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena verañjassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.16: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ticīvarena acchādesi. ekamekaṃ ca bhikkhuṃ ekamekena dussayugena acchādesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.17: atha kho bhagavā verañjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.18: atha kho bhagavā verañjāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā anupagamma soreyyaṃ saṅkassaṃ kannakujjaṃ, yena payāgapatiṭṭhānaṃ, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā payāgapatiṭṭhāne gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttaritvā yena bārāṇasī tadavasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.19: atha kho bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.20: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:4.21: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.0.1: pārājikakaṇḍo 2. [tatrime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti]
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyā avidūre kalandagāmo nāma hoti. tattha sudinno nāma kalandaputto seṭṭhiputto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.2: atha kho sudinno kalandaputto sambahulehi sahāyakehi saddhiṃ vesāliṃ agamāsi kenacideva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.4: addasā kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavantaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ. disvānassa etadahosi: “yannūnāhampi dhammaṃ suṇeyya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.5: atha kho sudinno kalandaputto yena sā parisā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.7: “yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.8: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.9: atha kho sā parisā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.10: atha kho sudinno kalandaputto aciravuṭṭhitāya parisāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.11: “yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.12: icchāmahaṃ bhante kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.14: “anuññāto’si pana tvaṃ suddinna mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā?”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.15: “na kho ahaṃ bhante anuññāto mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.1.16: “na kho sudinna tathāgatā ananuññātaṃ mātāpitūhi puttaṃ pabbājentī”ti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.4: sace tumhe sudinnaṃ nānujānissatha agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya, tattheva maraṇaṃ āgamissati.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.6: sace sudinno nābhiramissati agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya, kā tassa aññā gati bhavissati? idheva paccāgamissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.9: atha kho sudinnassa kalandaputtassa sahāyakā yena sudinno kalandaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sudinnaṃ kalandaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.10: “uṭṭhehi samma sudinna, anuññāto’si mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.11: atha kho sudinno kalandaputto “anuññāto’mhi kira mātā pitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā”ti haṭṭho udaggo pāṇinā gattāni paripuñchanto uṭṭhāsi.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.13: “anuññāto’mhi ahaṃ bhante, mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.4.15: alattha kho sudinno kalandaputto bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. alattha upasampadaṃ.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:5.5.10: kalandagāme sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena sakapitunivesanaṃ, tenupasaṅkami.
